decisions.statement: A subagent's page is landed by a program rather than by an agent.
A landing here owes no reading and runs no check.
A landing outlives the call that asked for the landing.
The landing of a page composed mints the id that page keeps.
A subagent whose page is in history takes up that page rather than a new page.
The page taken up is the page the newest commit wrote at the same path.
A page is taken up only where the agent id that page states is the agent id asked for.
A page taken up keeps the id and the kind that page had.
A page taken up takes back the readings its seat kept for it.
A page composed rather than taken up takes back no reading.
A landing that refused takes back no reading.
A put-up whose seat the index has no page for takes back no reading.
A put-up drops the readings its seat keeps for subagents that cannot resume.
A subagent cannot resume where its last record predates the client running.
The client weighed is the one holding the seat rather than the one that opened it.
A page taking its readings back is served before that drop runs.
A seat with no transcript or no holding process drops nothing.
A drop that throws never refuses the put-up it ran under.
A put-up that refused drops nothing.
The commit says whether the page was taken up or composed.
A root is carried in the call rather than read off the code's own path.
A seat the index has no page for writes nothing.
A page states the assignment its seat states.
A page taken up states the assignment history has only where its seat states no assignment.
A seat stating no assignment writes nothing where no page is in history either.
A page history states the kind for is written though the call names no kind.
A call naming no kind writes nothing where history states no kind either.
A call that wrote nothing answers why rather than answering that the call did not.
The reason a landing refused is the reason that call answers with.
A landing that committed before it stopped names that commit in that reason.
Every line the program left to finish says goes to a log named for this module.
Every line that log has opens with the time that line was written.
The time is put on where the line is written rather than where a reason is made.
A time is said to the millisecond with the offset that time was written at.
That log is in the seat's own folder beside the seat's supervisor log.
The seat whose folder has that log is named by the id the call has.
A log that will not open leaves the landing asked for and its output dropped.
A page states the agent id the subagent acts under.
The seat's id reaches here in the call rather than being read back from a name.
A call to write that has no seat id writes nothing.
A page already there is left as that page is.
A page that is not there is taken away by doing nothing.
What a page has beside it moves onto that page's seat before the page goes.
A page left where it is moves nothing onto its seat.
A take-down whose seat the index has no page for leaves a page with edits waiting where it is.
That take-down takes a page with no edits waiting away as any other take-down does.
A reader asks why a page is left where it is without moving anything.
A run beginning writes the moment that run began beside the page.
A page whose run began after the stop asked for is left where it is.
A page whose subagent the seat's transcript names as one that has not returned is left where it is.
The seat whose transcript is read is named by the agent id the page states.
A subagent the transcript names below another subagent is named as one at the top is.
A take-down may fail to take a page that is done, and may never take a page that is not.
A page goes only where the transcript was read and does not name its subagent as running.
A page a stop is written beside goes without the transcript being read.
The commit says a page went because the subagent was stopped from the panel.
A seat stating no transcript leaves the page where it is.
A transcript that will not open leaves the page where it is.
A page whose own agent id will not be read leaves the page where it is.
A reading that ends in an error leaves the page where it is.
The reading a take-down judges by is handed in rather than reached for.
A page left where it is over a transcript writes no line to the log.
A page left where nothing could be read says to the log which step settled that.
That line names the page it left as every line here names what it acted on.
A stop told no moment takes the page away rather than leaving it.
A subagent is looked for among the seat's own rather than among the subagents below those.
The moment is the last argument each act takes.
The page a seat sits at is read from the index rather than composed from a name.
A page that goes takes the files beside that page with it.
A take-down leaves the readings of the page it took where they are.
A sweep drops the readings of the pages the sweep took.
A page comes up through the change adding a page rather than through a raw edit.
A page goes through the change taking a page away rather than through a raw edit.
The landing a page comes up or goes through is handed in.
A path the index files no page at refuses the take-down rather than falling back.
Whether a landing here is asked for again is judged by the module asking again.
Each ask composes the page again rather than resuming the landing that refused.
A page another process wrote meanwhile is left as that page is.
A take-down refused for a lock is asked for again as a put-up is.
A held lock refuses a landing here rather than ending the run that asked for it.
A landing a held lock refused leaves its reason in the log as any refusal does.
What each page under a seat has beside it moves onto the seat before that page goes.
A seat the index has no page for sweeps its pages without moving anything.
A sweep leaves a page whose subagent the transcript names as running.
A sweep takes a page it could read nothing for, where a take-down leaves that page.
A sweep is where a page no take-down would take is reclaimed.
A sweep reaches only the pages the module naming a page says are under that seat.
A slug no `export const` may be declared under writes nothing.
Whether a slug names an export is judged by the decision the name check judges by.
A body is composed by the module that composes a subagent's body.

definition: a subagent's page put up while it works and taken away when it is done
